headline: Bitcoin Tumbles as Crypto Sentiment Nears Rock Bottom
summary: Bitcoin has tumbled as crypto sentiment nears rock bottom. Veterans brace for more pain amid fears surrounding artificial intelligence and quantum computing.
why: Cryptocurrency market sentiment heavily influences retail and institutional capital flows across digital asset exchanges.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Negative market sentiment and macro fears directly drive selling pressure on bitcoin prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Deteriorating market sentiment and emerging technological fears prompted widespread selling across digital assets.
